one_line: Karkota king of Kashmir who fused martial prowess with intense patronage of immigrant scholars amid a fraught fiscal crisis.

appearance.age_look: Early 30s, tall and athletic with a commander’s posture.
appearance.face: Oval face, medium wheatish Kashmiri complexion, sharp nose, high cheekbones and defined jaw; keen, slightly narrowed eyes that convey both intelligence and intensity; calm, thoughtful default expression with a hint of stern resolve.
appearance.hair: Thick, straight black hair drawn back into a neat topknot at the crown, the rest tied and tucked under a fitted golden diadem-band; a narrow Kashmiri-style cloth headband in deep red sits beneath the diadem, visible at the temples.
appearance.costume: He wears a long-sleeved, mid-thigh Kashmiri tunic (angarkha-style overlap) of rich deep blue wool with fine dark red piping along the neckline and wrap edge, belted at the waist with a wide golden-brown leather girdle; over this falls a soft, shoulder-length shawl of pale cream pashmina with a subtle woven border in muted green and maroon, draped from left shoulder across his chest and back; his lower body is clad in closely wrapped cream-coloured churidar-style trousers, tucked into sturdy mid-calf brown leather riding boots; jewellery is minimal but regal: the slim golden diadem-band with a small central circular green stone, a single gold torque necklace at the collarbone, and simple gold bangles on each wrist; textiles read as wool and pashmina, with subtle geometric vine motifs along the shawl border but otherwise plain solids for a dignified royal scholar-warrior look.
appearance.signature: A long, straight steel sword with a simple iron cross-guard and gently rounded pommel bound in dark brown leather, sheathed in a plain wooden scabbard faced with bronze fittings, worn at his left hip and held in his right hand when posed.

ref_desc: Jayapida Vinayaditya is a tall, athletic Kashmiri king with an oval wheatish face, black topknot hair under a golden diadem, deep blue tunic, cream shawl and trousers, brown boots, simple gold ornaments, and a plain long steel sword with bronze-fitted scabbard in a blue-cream-red-brown-green palette.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Jayapida Vinayaditya as a Kashmiri Karkota king: early 30s, tall and athletic, oval wheatish face with sharp nose, high cheekbones and intelligent, slightly narrowed eyes, wearing a calm, thoughtful, slightly stern expression. His thick black hair is drawn into a neat topknot, tied and tucked beneath a slim golden diadem-band with a small central green stone, and a narrow dark red cloth headband is visible beneath the diadem at his temples. He wears a rich deep blue long-sleeved angarkha-style tunic that overlaps at the front, with fine dark red piping along the neckline and wrap edge, cinched at the waist by a wide golden-brown leather girdle. Over his left shoulder and across his chest is a pale cream pashmina shawl with a subtle woven border in muted green and maroon, draping to about shoulder length and flowing across his back. His lower body is covered by cream churidar-style fitted trousers, closely wrapped and tucked into sturdy mid-calf brown leather riding boots. Show minimal but regal jewellery: the slim golden diadem, a single gold torque necklace at the collarbone, and simple gold bangles on each wrist. His signature weapon is a long, straight steel sword with a plain iron cross-guard and rounded leather-bound pommel, resting in a simple wooden scabbard with bronze fittings at his left hip; in the model sheet he lightly holds the hilt in his right hand. Use a palette dominated by deep blue, cream, dark red, brown leather, and muted green, and clearly display his face, hair, diadem, shawl, tunic, trousers, boots, and sword from head to toe in a neutral standing pose suitable for consistent redrawing.
